units.exact_image_prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render.
Asset type: a single isolated part reference for local TripoSG reconstruction, not a finished furniture scene.
Input image 1: the exact supplied Bed.blend Master_Leg graybox, used ONLY as structural proportions, orientation and mounting intent.
Primary request: Create ONE rococo walnut bed support leg. Preserve the reference's substantial roughly square cross-section and approximately 2.7–2.8-to-1 height-to-width/depth relationship; do not make a thin spindle. Develop a coherent cabriole form with a broad square upper mounting block, a substantial softly curved and tapering shaft, and ONE grounded carved foot. Prefer bilateral symmetry about the vertical plane through the outward 45-degree corner bisector so the same master can later be rotated into four corners. This is a soft design cue; show a single leg, never four views or four legs.
Materials/design: warm walnut, restrained rococo scroll carving and flowing acanthus motifs; readable main structural body with modest ornament. Do not let carving replace the structural volume.
Guide dimensions X/Y/Z: 0.259671 / 0.246630 / 0.692866. The graybox is a proportion and anchor reference, NOT a cage: ornament and curved silhouette may extend beyond it. Retain the support height, a clearly flat upper attachment area, and a usable foot contact region. Do not simply texture a cuboid.
Composition: one complete upright leg, same three-quarter orthographic view, camera roll and broad orientation as the guide. Whole object centered with generous transparent margin, upper surface and foot fully visible. Neutral product visualization, even soft studio light, no cast ground shadow or ground plane. Actual transparent alpha background.
Constraints: exactly ONE support leg. NO tabletop, seat, horizontal rail, bed frame, headboard, footboard, mattress, additional legs, whole bed, whole desk, room, base plinth, text, watermark, or multi-view collage. This is an UNREVIEWED reference candidate; do not add labels to the image.
